integrity: The arc angle is derived from exact hyperbolic cosine laws; length uses the polar metric and area uses Gauss-Bonnet. A standalone checker replays independent unsimplified identities and limiting regimes.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for regular odd-sided Reuleaux bodies in curvature -1. The n=3 endpoint is prior work. Full historical access to Santaló 1945 and Leichtweiss 2005 was unavailable, leaving a residual originality risk.
title: Exact area and perimeter of regular hyperbolic Reuleaux polygons
